coordinateSummary.warning: All newly created positions are development-stage corridor reconciliations or public place-area anchors. They must be replaced with exact authoritative stop coordinates without changing composite IDs.

topologyDecisions: Line 012 is stored as two independently ordered open patterns: Altea to La Vila Joiosa and La Vila Joiosa to Altea.
Line 054 is stored as two independently ordered open patterns: La Vila Joiosa to Benidorm bus station and the reverse published direction.
All four patterns use closesLoop false; no reverse sequence or last-to-first edge is inferred.
The same terminal StopNode may end one pattern and begin the opposite pattern without converting the pair into a closed cycle.
Shared BND, FIN and VIL composite identities are reused exactly across Lines 012 and 054 and from accepted prior scenarios.
Bare numeric codes rendered by the official pages are normalized only when surrounding route context makes the municipality prefix unambiguous.
identityDecisions: All accepted shared objects are copied exactly from prior Benidorm scenarios.
VIL 730 and VIL 731 remain distinct directional Huit de Maig terminal identities.
VIL 848/VIL 850 and VIL 849/VIL 851 remain separate directional C/ Llebeig identities.
ALT 479 and ALT 482 remain distinct El Planet/Cap Blanc direction-specific identities.
VIL 715 is shared exactly by both routes and both directions where the operator code matches.
Every new StopNode receives a singleton StopPlace; proximity and paired street names do not merge identities.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty for new nodes because no individual OSM platform or stop_position object was adopted as strict runtime evidence.

reviewItems.detail: Replace all 38 newly created development positions with exact authoritative coordinates while preserving composite IDs and cross-package exact equality.
Verify ALT 479/482, BND 386 and VIL 848-853 against an authoritative downloadable stop registry; current prefixes are explicit source-context reconciliations.

The selected operator pages displayed ordered route lists for 2026-06-26 even where the timetable panel showed no service for that date. Route topology is preserved; service calendar modeling remains outside this scenario graph.
